mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_intake(application_id,created_by,layout,request_key,request_hash,status,detail) VALUES(#{applicationId},#{createdBy},#{layout},#{requestKey},#{requestHash},'UPLOADED','업로드 완료 · 분석 시작 전')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document_intake WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM document_intake WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM document_intake WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}

SELECT j.id,j.application_id,j.status,j.progress FROM document_intake j JOIN application a ON a.id=j.application_id WHERE a.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND a.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND a.program_id=#{programId} AND a.status='DRAFT' AND j.status IN ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM intake_source WHERE intake_id=#{intakeId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM document_intake WHERE status='QUEUED' AND execution_mode='LIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE document_intake SET execution_mode='LIVE',status='QUEUED',stage='UPLOADED',detail='분석 대기',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADED'

UPDATE document_intake SET status='PROCESSING',stage='READING',progress=10,claim_token=#{token},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,25,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE document_intake SET stage=#{stage},progress=#{progress},detail=#{detail},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE document_intake SET status='READY',stage='COMPLETE',progress=100,detail='원본·분할 문서·추출 사진 정리 완료',result_json=#{result},lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE document_intake SET status='FAILED',error_code=#{error},lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE document_intake SET status='APPLIED',result_json=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='READY'

UPDATE document_intake FORCE INDEX(ix_intake_live_expiry) SET status='FAILED',error_code='PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE execution_mode='LIVE' AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT a.workspace_id,a.owner_id,j.request_hash FROM document_intake j JOIN application a ON a.id=j.application_id WHERE j.id=#{id}
SELECT payload FROM intake_analysis_cache WHERE workspace_id=#{scope.workspace_id} AND owner_id=#{scope.owner_id} AND request_hash=#{scope.request_hash} AND pipeline_version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO intake_analysis_cache(workspace_id,owner_id,request_hash,pipeline_version,payload) VALUES(#{scope.workspace_id},#{scope.owner_id},#{scope.request_hash},#{version},#{payload}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload=VALUES(payload),created_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE document_intake SET execution_mode='PREPARED',status='PROCESSING',stage='LOADING',progress=5,detail='준비된 인식 결과 불러오기',replay_started_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),claim_token='prepared',lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADED'
mapper.select: SELECT *,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,replay_started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))/1000000.0 AS elapsed_seconds FROM document_intake WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND execution_mode='PREPARED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE document_intake SET stage=#{stage},progress=#{progress},detail=#{detail},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND execution_mode='PREPARED' AND status='PROCESSING'
